title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (React / Python / Go or Node.js or Java)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and either Golang, Node.js, or Java experience with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building the AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js/Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.


The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!


Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.


Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities


  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience


  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when youve made a mistake


Desired Experience


  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information


  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values


  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. Theres no excuse for being a jerk.
  • Evidence-Based Decisions : Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners.
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do.
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.
  • The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient


We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Web Content Editor / Web QA (Growth Role)
description:
Location: Brazil

Team: Digital / Web


Company Description


Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity.


Role Overview


We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time.


You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks.


You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience.


Key Responsibilities:


Content Editing & Publishing

  • Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines.
  • Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages.
  • Manage and update content within a CMS (e.g., Sanity, WordPress, or similar).
  • Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders.
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates.


UX, Accessibility & Content Quality

  • Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization.
  • Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.g., alt text, content structure, readability).
  • Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization.
  • Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation.


Web QA & Quality Ownership

  • Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards.
  • Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues.
  • Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content.
  • Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership.


Performance & Optimization

  • Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics).
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content.
  • Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review.


Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations.
  • Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS).
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices.
  • Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues.
  • Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance.
  • Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows.
  • Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time.


Nice to Have

  • Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes.
  • Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments.
  • Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists.


Growth Opportunity

This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

description:

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. Possui mais de 1 bilhão de reais sob gestão, captou 75 milhões em rodada de investimentos e atua com clientes em todo o Brasil.


O Desafio e o Time de Modelagem

Como uma startup em constante desenvolvimento, nosso ambiente é dinâmico e exige autonomia. O Time de Modelagem é enxuto e focado em resolver problemas complexos de risco de crédito e de análise de dados no agronegócio. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados experiente, com perfil voltado para mentoria e trabalho em equipe.

Acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho livre e flexível, por isso, a confiança é a base de tudo que fazemos. Valorizamos pessoas movidas a novos desafios, capazes de desbravar o agronegócio e nos ajudar na nossa principal missão, que é levar para o agronegócio o insumo mais importante: o crédito.


Dia a dia

  • Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning, especialmente modelos de credit scoring e análise de risco.
  • Produtizar os modelos, trabalhando de forma autônoma desde a concepção até a implementação em ambiente de produção.
  • Colaborar com a liderança técnica na definição da arquitetura de dados e nas escolhas tecnológicas do time.
  • Traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados, comunicando os resultados de forma clara para audiências técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Colaborar dinamicamente com os times de produto e engenharia.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências e melhores práticas em Engenharia e Ciência de Dados.


Requisitos

  • 3+ anos de experiência atuando como Cientista de Dados, preferencialmente em ambientes de startup ou empresas de tecnologia.
  • Domínio em probabilidade e estatística e em modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados.
  • Domínio em Python e principais bibliotecas para Ciência de Dados (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc.).
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL (modelagem, performance e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados).
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de pipelines de machine learning ponta a ponta em produção (exploração e preparação de dados, limpeza, engenharia de atributos, modelagem e avaliação), com foco em escalabilidade, reprodutibilidade, segurança e monitoramento contínuo de performance dos modelos.
  • Experiência com práticas de engenharia para produção de modelos, incluindo versionamento de código com Git/Github, deploy em nuvem, automação de fluxos e suporte ao monitoramento e manutenção dos modelos em produção.
  • Familiaridade com serviços em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Perfil proativo, com capacidade para atuar em problemas ambíguos, autonomia para estruturar o caminho analítico e excelente habilidade de comunicação para alinhamento com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Interesse genuíno em evoluir tecnicamente em um ambiente dinâmico de fintech.


Diferenciais

  • Formação acadêmica em Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharias, Matemática, Física, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com modelagem de risco de crédito, credit scoring ou detecção de fraudes.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de inferência causal e experimentação.
  • Experiência em projetos envolvendo metaheurísticas aplicadas a problemas de otimização combinatória.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência prévia no setor do Agronegócio (AgTechs).
  • Experiência no setor de serviços financeiros ou em projetos relacionados a crédito e risco.
  • Conhecimento em manuseio de dags (Airflow ou similar) para composição de bases de dados para análises exploratórias e treinamento de modelos.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos - SP.
  • Remuneração compatível (PJ).
  • Benefício flexível via cartão Swile.
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass).
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde.
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto.

title: Market Data Database Support Engineer
description:
Company Description


Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide.


About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical Market Data Database Engineer support a market data platform handling real-time financial data and time-series database .

This role is focused on production support, deep diagnosis, and database troubleshooting in a fast-paced capital markets environment , working closely with traders, vendors, and engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced diagnosis and root cause analysis of production incidents related to market data systems
  • Support and troubleshoot time-series databases
  • Analyze data quality issues (missing, delayed, or incorrect market data)
  • Investigate system behavior using logs, queries, and system-level tools
  • Work with real-time data distribution systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Validate data using tools such as Refinitiv SLang
  • Collaborate with vendors (e.g. London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) , Bloomberg) to resolve data-related issues
  • Support incident management processes and ensure timely resolution
  • Develop small scripts (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for troubleshooting and automation
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring, alerting, and support processes


Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience in production support / application support
  • Proven expertise in diagnosis and root cause analysis (RCA)
  • Solid experience with databases (performance analysis, data validation)
  • Hands-on experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis
  • Good scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar)
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure


Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in banking / capital markets / trading environments
  • Knowledge of market data systems (TREP / RTDS)
  • Experience with Refinitiv SLang
  • Familiarity with Process Monitor (ProcMon) or similar diagnostic tools
  • Exposure to Bloomberg or Refinitiv/LSEG data platforms


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong investigative mindset – you enjoy digging into complex issues
  • Ability to trace problems across multiple layers (data source → ingestion → database → application)
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with global stakeholders
  • Structured and analytical thinking
  • Proactive approach to identifying and solving issues

What We Offer?

  • A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution
  • Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options
  • Continuous learning and certification opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Long-term career prospects with international exposure
  • Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

This role is focused on backend development, specifically supporting the migration of our customer support platform from Zendesk to Gladly, as well as maintaining and extending the integration services that power our support operations.

You'll be embedded in a small, collaborative engineering team working directly with Customer Support and Ticketing Platform teams. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, take pride in owning your code end-to-end, and enjoy meaningful technical work — this role is for you.

title: System Architect
description:
Project Description:

Owns the end-to-end vision and AI architecture for consumer devices. Defines scalable, power-efficient, and production-ready imaging and perception systems across product lines. Drives technical direction across sensor, ISP, CV, ML, and platform integration.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and own end-to-end vision system architecture (sensor → ISP → CV/ML → application layer).
  • Translate product and UX requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Define image quality strategy aligned with AI and user experience goals.
  • Architect reusable, modular CV/ML frameworks across multiple product SKUs.
  • Drive system-level trade-offs across performance, power, cost, and thermal limits.
  • Define AI model lifecycle strategy from training to OTA deployment.
  • Architect heterogeneous compute utilization (CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP).
  • Define system KPIs: latency, FPS, power, memory, boot time, and robustness.
  • Lead technology selection for inference engines, frameworks, and hardware platforms.
  • Guide SoC bring-up and performance validation for vision pipelines.
  • Establish coding standards, modularization strategy, and long-term maintainability.
  • Identify technical risks early and define mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with hardware, ISP, Android/Linux platform, and product teams.
  • Mentor senior engineers and provide architectural governance.
  • Contribute to long-term vision/AI roadmap across product generations.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field (PhD preferred).

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Temos uma oportunidade para Cientista de Dados Sênior para integrar o time da Tipspace. Buscamos um(a) profissional experiente e com paixão por games. Se você consegue transformar problemas reais em modelos robustos e mensuráveis , essa vaga é para você.


Sobre a Tipspace

A Tipspace é uma startup de games em rápido crescimento, focada em oferecer uma experiência inovadora para jogadores que desejam monetizar suas habilidades e competir em partidas valendo prêmios em dinheiro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é leve e descontraído, com uma cultura gamer forte – todos do time são apaixonados por jogos. Ao mesmo tempo, somos muito dedicados: trabalhamos duro para fazer a empresa dar certo e entregar a melhor experiência possível aos nossos usuários.


Tecnologias do Projeto

Para conseguir navegar, é importante que você esteja confortável com as tecnologias do nosso ambiente de dados e aprendizado. Você precisará dominar:

  • Bancos de Dados relacionais
  • Ambiente Delta Lake no Databricks
  • SQL para consultas estruturadas
  • Python, com ênfase em manipulação de dados e treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning
  • Git para controle de versões em bases compartilhadas de código


Responsabilidades

Como Cientista de Dados Sr. na Tipspace, você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver modelos de machine learning/IA: entender e transformar os principais desafios da plataforma em soluções inteligentes de aprendizado de máquina e inteligência artificial.
  • Configurar e analisar Testes A/B: desenhar e interpretar o resultado de testes que validem os efeitos esperados, seja dos modelos propostos ou de outras intervenções.
  • Realizar análises de produto: explorar o modelo de negócio da plataforma para propor e analisar melhorias na interface e na experiência dos usuários.
  • Comunicar suas descobertas: traduzir análises e conclusões em linguagem simples e engajar o time a adotar as melhorias propostas.
  • Colaborar com designers, product managers, desenvolvedores e marketing para entender problemas e pensar em soluções. Participar de discussões de negócio e ajudar a elevar o nível analítico do time.
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho dos modelos atuais, tanto na performance técnica quanto nos tempos de resposta e robustez em produção.


Requisitos

Procuramos alguém com o seguinte perfil e conhecimentos:

  • Graduação completa, diploma com forte base matemática e estatística. Pós-graduação ou mestrado/doutorado na área de ciência de dados é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em SQL para levantamento de dados. Experiência prévia com Databricks é um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento avançado de Python para manipulação de dados, usando pandas e scikit-learn para treinamento de modelos de aprendizado estatístico. Conhecimento de MLOps é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em análises de negócio: domínio dos conceitos fundamentais de saúde financeira de uma empresa. Capacidade de criar narrativas e visualizações que influenciem ações a serem tomadas. Experiência em startups é um diferencial.
  • Experiência em análise de produto: fluência com métricas de engajamento e retenção e conforto em analisar impacto de features e mudanças de jornada.
  • Noções básicas de ETL para entendimento do stack de dados. Experiência com DBT é um diferencial.
  • Boas Práticas: Código versionado com Git, familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Perfil Proativo: Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas, aprender rapidamente e buscar soluções. Boa comunicação para trabalhar em um time interdisciplinar.
  • Cultura Gamer: Importante: ser gamer e ter paixão por jogos! Valorizamos membros do time que entendam nosso público e se identifiquem com o universo dos games, pois nossa plataforma gira em torno disso.


Benefícios e Condições

  • Local de trabalho: 100% Remoto. Você pode trabalhar de qualquer lugar, contando que tenha boa internet e disponibilidade para colaborar com o time em horário comercial (fuso de Brasília).
  • Contratação: Regime PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – contrato como prestador de serviço.
  • Remuneração: Faixa de R$ 15.000 a R$ 22.000 por mês, negociável conforme sua proficiência e experiência. Valorizamos talentos e estamos abertos a discutir o salário dentro desse range.
  • Ambiente de Trabalho: Cultura de startup com ambiente informal e descontraído. Aqui você terá liberdade para experimentar novas ideias e soluções. Apesar do clima leve, trabalhamos com muita dedicação e foco – nosso time veste a camisa para fazer a Tipspace decolar!
  • Desafios e Crescimento: Oportunidade de impactar diretamente um produto inovador no mercado de games. Se você tem paixão por dados e por games, vai se sentir em casa e ter a chance de crescer junto com a empresa.


Se animou com a vaga? Estamos empolgados para conhecer pessoas talentosas que queiram criar algo grandioso conosco. Venha fazer parte da Tipspace e ajude-nos a transformar a forma como os gamers interagem e competem online!


Boa sorte e até breve

About California Labor Solutions

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.


What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations?

In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality… that’s where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company’s policies. 


We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.

·      Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL

Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.  


As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Este(a) profissional ficará alocado dentro do time ART (Advanced Rail Tecnology) atuando em projetos de tecnologia aplicáveis a ferrovias, com a oportunidade de interface direta junto a times globais. Para ser bem-sucedido(a) nesta posição, além de sólida experiência em back-end e Front-End, é essencial que o(a) profissional tenha um nível de inglês avançado e competências como proatividade, capacidade de liderança e comunicação. Estamos fazendo história na indústria ferroviária e você pode fazer parte disso!


Quem somos:

Somos a Progress Rail, uma empresa do grupo Caterpillar, e um dos maiores fornecedores de soluções e tecnologias de material rodante e infraestrutura para o setor ferroviário global.


Propósito do cargo

Criar aplicações das tecnologias web completas, criando aplicações do zero e integrando-as com outras ferramentas vigentes, a fim de entregar um trabalho com aplicações de qualidade e completas.


Tarefas Detalhadas:

  • Desenvolver aplicações Java escaláveis e resilientes, com foco em arquitetura orientada a alta performance e excelente experiência do usuário em ambientes web e desktop.
  • Construção de interfaces modernas com Angular: Utilizar Angular com TypeScript, HTML5, para desenvolver interfaces dinâmicas e responsivas.
  • Debugging e otimização contínua: Diagnosticar e corrigir bugs e aplicar melhorias para garantir eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade das aplicações.
  • Colaboração multidisciplinar: Coordenar o fluxo de trabalho com desenvolvedores front-end e back-end, promovendo sinergia na construção de APIs RESTful e interfaces intuitivas.
  • Ambiente com metodologias ágeis: Atuar utilizando frameworks ágeis como Scrum e Kanban para garantir entregas contínuas e colaborativas.
  • Segurança e proteção de dados: Implementar práticas modernas de segurança, como criptografia, autenticação robusta e prevenção contra vulnerabilidades.
  • Otimizar a usabilidade e a performance da aplicação, desenvolvendo funcionalidades que simplifiquem a navegação e aumentem a eficiência da interação do usuário com o sistema.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações web, atuando em projetos com foco em escalabilidade, performance e arquitetura bem definida.
  • Domínio avançado em Java, com vivência prática em Core Java e frameworks como Spring (Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Boot), Hibernate e construção de APIs RESTful seguindo princípios de design orientado a recursos.
  • Conhecimento em Angular (versão 10+) como framework principal de front-end.
  • Familiaridade com bibliotecas complementares, como Bootstrap e jQuery, com foco em compatibilidade e responsividade.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de build e versionamento, como Maven/Gradle, Git/GitHub, além de práticas de integração contínua com Jenkins e uso de containers via Docker.
  • Vivência com ambientes em nuvem (AWS), experiência com computação em nuvem AWS e banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Participação ativa em times ágeis, utilizando metodologias como Scrum e Kanban, com envolvimento em rituais como planning, daily, reviews e retrospectivas.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento teórico e prático em Gerência de Configuração de Software (itens de configuração, versionamento, baselines, releases e auditorias).
  • Experiência na definição e implantação de processos formais de CM em ambientes de desenvolvimento.
  • Integração de práticas de CM com DevOps, CI/CD e métodos ágeis.


Idioma:

Inglês avançado (capacidade de leitura e conversação).


Formação:

Nível Superior em Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou similares.


Habilidades

  • Compatibilidade com Nossos Valores em Ação (Código de Conduta da Caterpillar);
  • Proatividade: É capaz de identificar e de maneira autônoma e antecipada solucionar problemas.
  • Comunicação: É capaz de expressar com clareza, ideias, pensamentos e conceitos, de forma a influenciar outros ou obter apoio.
  • Atenção a Detalhes: É capaz de verificar e interpretar fatos, planos ou projetos de forma minuciosa, contribuindo para qualidade e análise de impacto.
  • Flexibilidade: É capaz de administrar mudanças corporativas, conforme demandas de negócio, adaptando-se no ritmo necessário.


O que estamos oferecendo para esta posição:

  • Contrato CLT
  • Plano de saúde para você e seus dependentes
  • Plano odontológico para você e seus dependentes
  • Vale refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Seguro de vida
  • Aplicativo para descontos em academias
  • Aplicativo para descontos em medicamentos em farmácias
  • PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Subsídio para educação continuada
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida.

title: Analista I de Desenvolvimento de Softare | Python
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


DESAFIO

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Python para integrar nosso time, focado

em construir e manter soluções técnicas de alta qualidade. Se você gosta de trabalhar com

metodologias ágeis e de criar aplicações escaláveis, essa oportunidade é para você.

  • Desenvolver e realizar a manutenção de aplicações utilizando frameworks Python (como FastAPI, Flask ou similares).

  • Experiência prática e comprovada com desenvolvimento em Python e frameworks web (FastAPI, Flask ou similares).
  • Sólida habilidade na construção, manutenção e consumo de APIs.
  • Vivência com modelagem e uso de bancos de dados relacionais (SQL) e não relacionais (NoSQL).
  • Domínio de versionamento de código utilizando GIT.


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência específica com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado e prático em arquitetura REST.
  • Vivência ou familiaridade com arquitetura de Microsserviços.
  • Prática na escrita de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração), preferencialmente utilizando pytest.

  • Boa base em conceitos de arquitetura de software e vivência com frameworks ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: AI Automations Engineer
description:
About Evvolve & Partners

Evvolve & Partners connects a select group of founders and investors through our private network, Evvolve Circle. With $2B+ in completed transactions and relationships with 305+ family offices globally, we facilitate highly curated introductions in the private markets.


You can learn more about our platform and .


The Role

We are hiring an AI Automation Engineer to help build and own the internal automation systems that power our deal flow and investor engagement.


This role sits at the intersection of operations, data, and AI-driven workflows. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining complex automation processes that connect our core systems, structure internal data, and support communication with investors and founders. You will play a key role in building scalable workflows that improve operational efficiency and ensure reliable information flow across our platform.


Responsibilities

  • Design and manage multi-step automation workflows using n8n to support internal operations
  • Build systems that connect and synchronize data across Supabase, Attio, and Airtable
  • Develop structured workflows that process operational data, generate internal reports, and support activity tracking
  • Implement AI-supported workflows that process unstructured inputs into structured outputs
  • Ensure reliability across workflows through testing, monitoring, and error-handling logic
  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate internal processes and improve operational efficiency


Profile

  • 2–4 years experience in automation engineering, workflow architecture, or low-code development
  • Strong experience building workflows in n8n or similar platforms (Make, Zapier, Retool, etc.)
  • Comfortable working with APIs, JSON data structures, and workflow logic
  • Experience working with databases and writing SQL queries (Supabase/PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Familiarity with integrating AI APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic within automated workflows
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on building reliable, scalable systems
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to take ownership of internal tooling and automation


Why Evvolve?

  • Direct exposure to senior management and the opportunity to contribute to core operational systems
  • A lean, merit-based environment where strong work and initiative are quickly recognized
  • A fast-paced, fully remote team focused on building efficient, high-impact internal tools

title: Senior RPA Developer (Python)
description:
Senior RPA Developer (Python)

title: Software Engineer C# Sênior
description:
Somos a startup que mais cresce na América Latina e estamos no caminho para conquistar o status de unicórnio ainda em 2025. Atuamos com soluções tecnológicas que simplificam e conectam pessoas, impactando positivamente a vida de milhares de usuários. Já contamos com mais de 100 mil veículos em circulação, presença em mais de 100 filiais no Brasil e no México.


Se você busca crescimento acelerado, desafios constantes e a chance de transformar o futuro da mobilidade na região, aqui é o lugar certo para você.



Responsabilidades


  • Atuar em um ambiente de alta performance, com entusiasmo por ver seus resultados impactando milhares de clientes diariamente;
  • Colaborar ativamente com o time, com boa comunicação, disposição para aprender e compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Demonstrar perfil analítico e proativo, com foco em melhoria contínua;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, com testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia de software;

  • Forte atuação no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network

By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Account Manager
description:
• LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
  • WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
  • BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?


Oneday is a VC-backed EdTech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.


We have raised $20M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.


We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.


What you’ll do..

As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
  • Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
  • Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
  • Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
  • Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
  • Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
  • Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates


This is not a passive customer success role.

It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.


You’ll likely do well here if you:

  • Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
  • Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
  • Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
  • Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
  • Take feedback well and apply it
  • Have strong written and spoken English skills
  • Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results


What you’ll get:

  • Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
  • Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer (LLMs, RAG & Agents)


Estamos em busca de um AI Engineer para atuar na evolução da nossa plataforma com foco na construção de sistemas inteligentes baseados em LLMs, agentes e bases de conhecimento.


Essa pessoa fará parte do time de engenharia e será responsável por desenvolver soluções de IA aplicadas ao produto, integrando modelos de linguagem com dados reais, sistemas internos e fluxos de negócio.


Nosso objetivo é construir uma plataforma orientada a inteligência artificial, com uso de RAG, agentes e múltiplas bases de conhecimento (relacionais, vetoriais e grafos), aplicadas a contextos educacionais e corporativos.


Não buscamos um perfil acadêmico ou focado em treinamento de modelos. Buscamos alguém que saiba transformar IA em produto real.


O que você vai fazer:


  • Desenvolver funcionalidades baseadas em LLMs integradas à plataforma
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Estruturar e evoluir bases de conhecimento (dados estruturados, vetoriais e grafos)
  • Construir e orquestrar agentes e fluxos de execução (tools, multi-agents, etc.)
  • Integrar IA com sistemas existentes (APIs, banco de dados, serviços internos)
  • Trabalhar na qualidade das respostas (avaliação, melhoria contínua, contexto)
  • Otimizar custo, latência e performance das aplicações de IA
  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia na evolução da arquitetura da plataforma


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com uso de LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares)
  • Experiência com construção de RAG e uso de embeddings
  • Experiência com integração de IA em aplicações reais (não apenas protótipos)
  • Conhecimento em APIs, backend e integração entre sistemas
  • Capacidade de estruturar e trabalhar com diferentes tipos de dados
  • Experiência com debugging e evolução de sistemas em produção
  • Mentalidade de engenharia (performance, custo, confiabilidade)


Stack e Tecnologias (IA e Dados):


  • LLMs e APIs de IA (OpenAI, Anthropic ou similares)
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
  • Bases vetoriais (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares)
  • Bases de grafos e conhecimento (Neo4j ou similares)
  • Orquestração de agentes (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno ou abordagens próprias)
  • Integração com APIs e serviços internos
  • Backend para orquestração (Node.js, Python ou PHP)


Perfil esperado:


  • Consegue transformar IA em funcionalidades reais de produto
  • Pensa em dados, contexto e qualidade de resposta
  • Não depende de frameworks específicos para resolver problemas
  • Consegue trabalhar com autonomia e explorar soluções
  • Equilibra experimentação com responsabilidade técnica

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior PHP
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior PHP 


Somos uma plataforma que ajuda investidores a encontrarem as melhores oportunidades de investimentos. Temos como base a filosofia Buy And Hold (Investimento de longo prazo). Trazemos para nossos usuários informações como: cotações, balanços, comparadores, históricos financeiros das empresas, gráficos, cursos, gerenciador de carteiras, entre outras funcionalidades. Lançada em dezembro de 2020, a plataforma vem tendo um ótimo crescimento, mensalmente já são mais de 18 milhões de pageviews acessadas.


Estamos procurando um desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior para se juntar à nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, possui sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos web, é especialista em PHP (Laravel) e tem boa experiência em Front-End com HTML, CSS e Javascript, esta pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você.


Escopo de atividades


  • Criação de ferramentas como: comparador de ações, gerenciador de investimentos (carteiras), calculadoras de investimentos, gráficos, relatórios, entre outros;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web escaláveis e eficientes em PHP;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para projetar e implementar novos recursos;
  • Realizar testes para garantir a qualidade do código;
  • Otimizar aplicações para melhorar o desempenho e a usabilidade;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de IA para apoio em desenvolvimento, revisão de código, testes e ganho de produtividade;
  • Contribuir com melhorias contínuas em processos, automações e uso estratégico de novas tecnologias;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e novas tecnologias.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada como desenvolvedor back-end em PHP;
  • Experiência comprovada como desenvolvedor front-end em React Native, HTML, CSS e Javascript;
  • Forte experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (por exemplo, MySQL, PostgreSQL);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Laravel;
  • Experiência com integração de APIs de terceiros;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de segurança web;
  • Experiência prática utilizando ferramentas de IA (como assistentes de código, geração de testes, análise de código ou automação de tarefas);
  • Capacidade de utilizar IA de forma crítica e responsável, validando resultados e mantendo qualidade técnica;
  • Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e comunicação;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe;
  • Conhecimento em Docker, Git, Padrões de desenvolvimento, Repository Pattern, Service Layer, Clean Code, Blade, Filas (Queue) - Horizon, Cache (Redis);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações em nuvem AWS (RDS, ECS, EC2);
  • Experiência com uso de IA aplicada a produto ou automação interna;
  • Certificações relevantes em desenvolvimento web;
  • Conhecimento e interesse pelo mercado financeiro;
  • Já investir ou ter investido em renda variável.


Informações Complementares:


  • Ambiente de trabalho agradável e organizado;

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

title: Credit Risk Analyst
description:
Credit Risk Analyst — Acquisition & Online Lending

Full-time Contractor (PJ) | 100% Remote | US Central Time hours


⚠️ This is NOT an FP&A, Treasury, or Controller role. If your background is financial planning, accounting, or back-book portfolio management, this role is not a match.


Our US fintech client — an online consumer lender — is looking for a Credit Risk Analyst who owns the front end of the credit funnel. This means acquisition-side risk: designing risk tiers, sequencing underwriting decisions, managing approval/decline trade-offs at the top of funnel, and building the logic that determines who gets credit and at what terms — before any loan hits the books.


If you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you.


What You'll Do

• Optimize risk tiers and underwriting sequences for online customer acquisition

• Analyze precision/recall trade-offs in credit decisioning models to balance approval volume and loss rates

• Support or develop dynamic acquisition pricing strategies tied to risk performance

• Design and refine multiple underwriting pathways (multi-path sequencing)

• Build and monitor rescue lane strategies to recover near-miss applicants

• Track and report on front-end risk KPIs: approval rate, take rate, early delinquency, cost per funded loan

• Work closely with data and product teams to improve decision engine logic


Requirements (Non Negotiable)

• 3+ years of experience in online consumer lending, BNPL, or a tangential fintech/e-commerce credit environment

• Hands-on acquisition/top-of-funnel risk experience: risk tier assessment, underwriting sequencing, or dynamic acquisition pricing

• Fluent English — interviews, daily standups, and all written communication are in English

• SQL proficiency — comfortable writing queries independently to analyze credit performance data

• Ability to work US Central Time hours (approx. 9am–6pm CT / 11am–8pm Brasília)


Nice to Have

• Experience with rescue lane management or near-miss recovery programs

• Background in fraud risk within the acquisition funnel

• Exposure to multi-path underwriting logic or decision engine configuration

• Portfolio monitoring and credit loss forecasting (post-acquisition)

• Experience at an e-commerce, marketplace lending, or embedded finance company


What We Offer

• PJ/contractor arrangement — compensation aligned with fintech market rates

• 100% remote — work from anywhere in Brazil

• US Central Time schedule — structured workday, no late nights

• Direct exposure to a fast-growing US online lending operation

Highly Desirable Skills

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

Desirable:

  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression

title: Salesforce Software Engineer
description:
We are hiring experienced Software Engineers  to join our team and build on the Salesforce platform. These are hands-on engineering roles — you will be writing code, designing solutions, and shipping features across a large, mature codebase. We are not looking for administrators or declarative-only builders; we need engineers who think in code and architecture.

We're hiring across both UI/Frontend  and Backend/Platform  specializations, and you'll work on a production Experience Cloud site built with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Bootstrap, supported by a robust backend of Apex services, integrations, and asynchronous processing.



What You'll Work On


Frontend / UI Engineers  will focus on:

  • Building and maintaining Lightning Web Components within an Experience Cloud site serving external users
  • Working with Bootstrap-based styling and responsive layouts alongside the LWC framework
  • Designing component architectures that are performant, accessible, and maintainable at scale
  • Integrating frontend components with Apex controllers, platform events, and real-time data flows

Backend / Platform Engineers  will focus on:

  • Designing and building Apex services, triggers, and automation across a complex data model
  • Implementing and maintaining asynchronous processing patterns including Queueable Apex, Batchable Apex, and Platform Events
  • Working with the Connect API and other Salesforce platform APIs
  • Building and supporting MuleSoft integrations for document processing and connectivity to external systems
  • Ensuring governor limit compliance, bulkification, and performance optimization across high-volume operations

All engineers  will contribute to code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.



Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline — we value a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, systems design, and software engineering principles
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , with a meaningful portion spent writing code on the Salesforce platform (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Visualforce)
  • Demonstrated experience building large-scale applications  — you've worked in codebases with significant complexity, not just small apps or proof-of-concept projects
  • Experience building cloud-native or cloud-hosted applications  — you understand multi-tenant architecture, API-driven design, and the tradeoffs of building on a managed platform
  • Proficiency with modern AI-assisted development tools  (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) — you actively use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review, and you understand how to validate and guide AI-generated output effectively
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals : version control (Git), testing strategies, CI/CD, separation of concerns, and clean code practices



Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud  (Community Cloud) site development
  • Hands-on experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC)  in production
  • Experience with MuleSoft  (Anypoint Platform, API-led connectivity, CloudHub)
  • Familiarity with Platform Events  and event-driven architecture on Salesforce
  • Experience with Batchable and Queueable Apex  patterns for high-volume data processing
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce Connect API
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II  (valued but not required — we care more about what you can build than what you've passed)
  • Experience with Bootstrap  or similar CSS frameworks in the context of LWC development
  • Familiarity with document processing pipelines and integration patterns

title: Customer Success Pleno
description:
Sobre a Payfy

A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Com cartões corporativos e tecnologia integrada, eliminamos relatórios de despesas, reduzimos complexidade administrativa e simplificamos a contabilidade de empresas de médio e grande porte.

Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia: quem entra precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.


O desafio

Você vai ser o ponto de contato estratégico dos nossos clientes — do onboarding ao crescimento contínuo. Sua missão é garantir que cada empresa da sua carteira use a plataforma de forma efetiva, identificando oportunidades de expansão e antecipando problemas antes que virem churns.

Essa não é uma posição para quem faz CS no piloto automático. É para quem usa IA para trabalhar mais rápido, se comunicar melhor e enxergar padrões antes que os dados gritem.


O que você vai fazer

  • Conduzir demonstrações e implantações de novos clientes, usando IA para personalizar apresentações e antecipar dúvidas com base no perfil de cada conta
  • Gerenciar carteira high touch com comunicação ativa e periódica, apoiada por automações e resumos gerados com IA
  • Mapear saúde dos clientes, identificar riscos de churn e oportunidades de expansão — usando dados e ferramentas de IA para acelerar análise
  • Registrar interações e manter CRM atualizado com agilidade, usando IA para estruturar notas e follow-ups



O que buscamos

  • Experiência em CS com foco em onboarding e carteiras high touch: sabe conduzir jornada do cliente do zero ao engajamento real
  • Uso de IA no trabalho: usa ferramentas como Claude, ChatGPT ou similares para escrever melhor, analisar mais rápido e automatizar etapas repetitivas. Não é IA por moda — é IA com propósito
  • Organização e agilidade: consegue gerenciar volume de clientes, demandas simultâneas e registros sem perder o fio da meada
  • Comunicação clara e direta: boa oratória, escrita objetiva e presença nas interações com o cliente
  • Senso de produto e negócio: entende o impacto do CS no resultado financeiro da empresa e do cliente



O que não buscamos

  • Quem faz CS só no relacionamento, sem interesse em dados, processos e melhoria contínua
  • Quem usa IA apenas para gerar textos genéricos, sem integrar ao processo real de trabalho
  • Perfis que precisam de muito contexto e direcionamento para tomar decisões simples



O que oferecemos

  • Contrato CLT — R$ 2.900 fixo + variável
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição — você escolhe
  • Assistência médica e odontológica 100% subsidiada pela empresa (após 3 meses)
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Wellhub + Conexa Saúde
  • Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível
  • Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e crescer junto com a tecnologia



Diversidade e Inclusão na Payfy

Você é livre para ser você. Valorizamos quem você quiser ser, independente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascêndência ou idade.


Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.

Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

TokenFlow is an onchain token clarity platform. A B2B product, giving protocols complete visibility of their token ecosystem, including: all holder addresses, all transactions and their types, market maker tracking and performance, DeFi positions, and much more.


We're a small, lean team with lots of experience in crypto and tokenomics. We've received funding, and we're looking for our first non-founder hire.



What You'll Do
  • Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs
  • Architect, deploy, and operate cloud-native systems on GCP, AWS, or Azure, optimized for performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Own DevOps workflows end-to-end — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Pulumi), container orchestration, and environment management
  • Build, operate, and optimize data ingestion and processing pipelines for high-volume, event-driven workloads
  • Integrate and manage RPC-based data sources, designing resilient systems for rate-limited, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data access
  • Design, query, and optimize relational databases, with a strong focus on data modeling, indexing, query performance, and schema evolution
  • Monitor and maintain system health — defining SLOs, setting up alerting, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks across services and databases
  • Apply security best practices across services — authentication, authorization, secrets management, input validation, and safe handling of sensitive data
  • Secure APIs and services against common vulnerabilities — injection, broken auth, and unauthorized access
  • Enforce HTTPS and encryption for data in transit and at rest, and apply least-privilege access across services and infrastructure
  • Run security checks in CI/CD pipelines, maintain audit logs for sensitive operations, and set up rate limiting to protect against abuse
  • Maintain a workflow, continuously identify risks, review access controls, patch vulnerabilities, and improve defenses as systems evolve
  • Integrate and secure crypto wallet flows in production — signing, transaction validation, and key management
  • Collaborate across product, data, and infrastructure to ship features end-to-end
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code


Requirements
  • Previous experience in fullstack, backend-focused software engineering, security engineering, or crypto/web3 development
  • Strong experience building backend services and APIs
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, query optimization, and schema design for performance at scale

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
The Role

Our client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform built for social media managers, agencies, and brands. We are self-funded, profitable, and moving fast, which means the people here are not here to coast. Everyone on this team has a goal they are building toward and puts in the work to get there. We are looking for a sharp, disciplined Account Executive who closes deals without losing the relationship along the way. You are not just good on a call. • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

Description

We are looking for a NetSapiens Engineer who lives and breathes VoIP architecture. As a key member of our Level 3 Technical Support team, you won't just be fixing tickets - you’ll be the ultimate escalation point and technical authority for our NetSapiens UCaaS ecosystem.


This is a unique hybrid role that blends deep platform engineering, infrastructure management, and high-stakes customer consulting. You’ll be the bridge between our internal development teams and our most valued reseller partners, ensuring that our communications backbone is performant, scalable, and resilient.


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient


Responsibilities
  • Configure, deploy, and maintain NetSapiens UCaaS platform environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex NetSapiens routing, provisioning, and service delivery issues.
  • Perform system optimization and performance tuning for the NetSapiens platform.
  • Manage integrations between NetSapiens and third-party systems or carriers.
  • Provide Level 3 technical support to customers and reseller partners, diagnosing escalated service issues.

  • Support internal development with NetSapiens API integrations and automated provisioning services.
  • Oversee platform upgrades and maintenance procedures to ensure high availability.
  • Participate in incident response and root cause analysis for critical data and voice services.
  • Collaborate with sales engineering on complex implementations to transform technical requirements into actionable solutions.
  • Contribute to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives for NetSapiens deployments using tools like Terraform or Ansible. 


Requirements
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with the NetSapiens platform (configuration, administration, and troubleshooting).
  • Strong understanding of SIP protocol , VoIP call flows, and general telecom fundamentals.
  • Expertise in network troubleshooting and packet analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark).
  • Experience with NetSapiens API and automation capabilities.
  • Proficiency in AWS cloud infrastructure and network security principles (DNS, NAT, firewalls).
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong proficiency in Linux system administration and scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Telecom industry certifications or AWS Certified Solutions Architect/Data Engineer status are preferred.

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Desenvolver e implantar fluxos de LLM para o ecossistema ERP Protheus, transformando dados complexos em soluções de negócio escaláveis.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • produção;
